orgName: EA SPORTS FC Supercup 2025/2026 (Lega Serie A)

source.name: Lega Serie A - EA SPORTS FC SUPERCUP TICKETING SEMIFINALS
source.note: 'Sela Sport, the event's organising partner, will be working with the Saudi Tourism Authority to sell tickets for all three matches' in Riyadh, 18-19 and 22 December 2025; tickets via webook.com.

note: Sela Sport was the December 2025 edition's organising partner. Sponsor recorded as 'Sela' (PIF-owned, already rated); whether Sela Sport's role continues in 2026-27, when the edition is not in Saudi Arabia, is unknown.
